ضَمْضَمٌ A lion that grasps everything; as also ↓ ضُمَاضِمٌ . (S.) [See also ضَمْضَامٌ: and see what here follows.] ―
-b2- Also, (S,) Angry; (S, K;) applied to a man: (S:) and, as also ↓ ضُمَاضِمٌ and ↓ صُمَضِمٌ , an angry lion: (K, TA:) or simply a lion: (TA:) and bold, or daring; (K, TA;) applied to a man. (TA.) ―
-b3- And Big, bulky, or corpulent: (K, TA:) but it is mentioned by IAar as with the unpointed ص. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
